# Welcome

to Buffs n Brew 

![BNB Background 2 PNG.png](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_2be12311513c40eba5d1a51ae62a6fac~mv2.png)

### About Us

If you're seeking to elevate your gameplay in Fallout 76 through the power of food buffs, look no further. This group is your ultimate resource for delving into the world of sustenance-enhanced survival.

Have burning questions about which food buffs align with your playstyle? Need advice on the best buffs for a particular scenario? Our community is here to answer your queries, share their experiences, and guide you toward making the most delectable decisions for your character.

Additional services: Enjoy using food buffs but don't have the time to farm? Let us do all the hard work. We provide made-to-order food buffs and deliver them to your camp doorstep.

### Donations

Are you someone who relishes exploring the Wasteland but is uncertain about what to do with the spoils? Or perhaps you have a passion for giving back to the community?

We invite you to consider contributing ingredients to the chefs at Buffs n Brew. Our BNB community thrives on the generosity of donations, ensuring everyone remains well-fed, and every contribution, no matter how small, goes a long way.

If you're interested in making a donation, kindly post in either our Discord or Facebook group, and one of our staff members will promptly get in touch with you.

Thank you for being a part of our community!
